tool_args.rationale: The saturating pilot response and bridge/flux-conservation signatures leave a genuine structural ambiguity. The open-branch probe can discriminate mechanisms before fitting a forecast model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating Beverton–Holt model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only u_now varies, so the pilot cannot distinguish saturation from the suggested mobility-bridge mechanism or identify dependence on the other inputs.
The open-branch probe is cheaper and more directly addresses the unresolved mechanism.
It is irrelevant to identifying the proposed bridge mechanism.
